mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in a month and the S&P 500 still produces positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for two consecutive months and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month and the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 45% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 45% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls simultaneously
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls simultaneously, and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and increasing real final sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both increase and the S&P 500 still produces negative 60-day forward returns in more than 45% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% signals tightening financial conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% during a tightening cycle and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 55% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.
